thread:
maria: Quick kickoff — vendor is asking for a 3‑week POC, must validate latency/cost/quality for chat summarization and embeddings. Can we confirm scope?
jamal: Sounds good. Use cases: live customer chat summarization (short prompts, high qps) + nightly batch embeddings for search.
kevin: Customer target: p95 < 300ms on chat gen with 2k context and 99% request success. Cost target: keep inference cost under $X per 1k messages (they gave budget range in doc).
olga: Security checklist: they need KMS for key separation, VPC peering, SOC2 evidence, and an answer for data retention policy. I'll handle questionnaire answers but need tech details from runtime.
maria: POC deliverables: 1) baseline perf (p50/p95/p99) for sample prompt set, 2) cost estimate under typical load, 3) eval suite with PASS/FAIL thresholds, 4) runbook for failover (model variant) and ramp plan.
jamal: For evals, we should use the customer's prompt set (they uploaded 1200 prompts). We'll supply an automated harness that runs 3qps/50qps/200qps profiles. Acceptance: quality A/B against their current baseline with >5% uplift on F1/ROUGE or no regressions depending on metric.
kevin: Timeline: week1 — infra + security preflight + sample prompt dry run. Week2 — full load/perf runs + cost calc. Week3 — consolidation, final report, and handoff. Customer wants go/no-go at end of week2.
maria: Quick technical asks for infra: do we run on Dedicated GPUs or Hosted for this test? Dedicated preferred for predictable p95 but hosted quicker to stand up.
jamal: Recommend Dedicated for chat perf tests (p95 sensitive), hosted for embeddings if we want fast iteration. We'll set up two routes.
olga: For KMS + VPC, we need the network IP ranges and the customer's peering contact. Also: they require logs for 90 days and audit events forwarded.
presales-bot: Deploy job queued: canary model deploy (gpt-xyz-quant) -> started
maria: Pricing question from customer: can we provide a blended rate for the POC (lower than list) and a committed rate if they convert to Dedicated?
jamal: We can offer a trial discount for POC; for Dedicated we need a commit and then we can provide tiered pricing. I'll prepare the numbers.
jamal: Performance targets to validate during POC: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms for chat (short prompts); embeddings p50 < 80ms. Error rate < 0.5% under load.
kevin: Also add cold-start behavior check — they care about tail when KV cache empty. Document degradation strategy: fallback to smaller variant (gpt-abc-lt) with warning.
maria: Eval thresholds: quality — static prompts: >= 0.85 similarity (their metric) on 95% of samples; for summaries a human spot-check of 30 samples with >80% acceptance. If any threshold fails, it's a 'needs remediation' not automatic fail.
jamal: Config snippet I'll use for load test: ```
route: dedicated-chat
model: gpt-xyz-quant
max_tokens: 1024
concurrency: 48
batching: auto
fallback_policy: prefer-variant:gpt-abc-lt
```
kevin: Nice. Who owns deploy & monitoring? Ops will own Dedicated cluster; presales to own test harness and results dashboard.
maria: Blockers: 1) Customer legal needs NDA addendum for prompt data, 2) Security team needs confirmation on forward-logs retention, 3) Billing wants PoC discount approval.
olga: I'll attach answers to the security questionnaire by EOD tomorrow. Need the exact model names and runtime logging endpoints.
jamal: I'll hand over the prompt set mapping and the harness repo link. @maria can you confirm the 3‑week calendar (we'll need approvals midweek)?
maria: Confirmed — I'll send calendar invites after legal signoff. Action items: Jamal (setup harness + config), Olga (SQ answers + KMS details), Kevin (coordinate customer schedule), Maria (approve pricing discount with finance).
kevin: Customer asked about SLA wording for POC report — can we include measured p95, error rate, and cost per 1k inference tokens?
maria: Yes, include those. Also include a 'risk matrix' (network, model quality, quota limits).
jamal: One more: let's capture warmup plan to pre-fill KV cache for realistic latency numbers. We'll run a 10min warmup at target QPS pre-run.
presales-bot: Canary deploy finished: all checks passed.
maria: OK team — I'll compile into a one-pager for the customer and share. Any other concerns?
kevin: Please confirm whether on-private deployment is required for final contract (they said maybe) — that'll affect timeline and security gating.
olga: If private is required, timeline extends by ~3 weeks for network + HSM integration. Noted.
maria: Great. I'll follow up with calendar and the one‑pager. Thanks all :thumbsup:
